title: Death Note Short Stories
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume collection of Death Note side stories. 'C-Kira' has Near, now in L's role, face a new Kira killing people aged 60 and over; 'a-Kira' gives the notebook to brilliant student Minoru Tanaka in a surveillance-heavy world ten years after Light's fall. It also includes the original pilot (Taro Kagami), comic vignettes of L at Wammy's House and four-panel gag strips.
life_message: Power over life and death tempts people toward self-made justice, and only intelligence, restraint and law hold it in check.
